summary: Comprehensive testing of Zubite.bg backend refactoring from monolithic server.py (2500+ lines) to modular FastAPI routers. All 22 backend API tests passed. Frontend admin dashboard, clinic-applications page, and clinic login page all load correctly with proper functionality.

minor.issue: InsecureKeyLengthWarning: HMAC key is 31 bytes, below recommended 32 bytes for SHA256 (RFC 7518 Section 3.2). Consider using a longer JWT_SECRET.

passed_tests: GET /api/ returns ok status with 'Zubite.bg API' message
GET /api/cities returns 4 cities (sofia, plovdiv, varna, haskovo)
GET /api/admin/leads returns list of leads (requires auth)
GET /api/blog/posts returns published posts with total
POST /api/clinic/login with valid credentials returns access_token
GET /api/clinic/leads returns leads assigned to clinic
Frontend: Admin login page loads at /admin
Frontend: Admin dashboard loads with leads table (48 leads)
Frontend: Clinic applications page shows 7 applications
Frontend: Clinic detail modal opens with 'Генерирай нова парола' button
Frontend: Clinic login page loads at /clinic with proper form
critical_code_review_comments: Backend refactoring successfully split 2500+ line monolithic server.py into 16 modular files
All routers properly organized: public.py, admin.py, blog.py, analytics.py, clinics.py, calls.py, verification.py, seo.py
Auth module (auth.py) properly implements JWT token creation and verification for both admin and clinic users
All API endpoints maintain identical URLs after refactoring - no breaking changes
Frontend clinic-applications page has proper data-testid attributes for testing
Minor: JWT_SECRET is 31 bytes, should be 32+ bytes per RFC 7518 (warning only, not breaking)

success_rate.frontend: 100% (All pages load correctly, all interactions work)

seed_data_creation: No new seed data created. Used existing data: 48 leads, 7 clinic applications, 4 clinic accounts.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Major backend refactoring completed and verified. The monolithic server.py was split into: config.py, database.py, auth.py, schemas.py, storage.py, scoring.py, emails.py, and 8 routers (public, admin, blog, analytics, clinics, calls, verification, seo). All API endpoints remain identical. Test file /app/backend/tests/test_refactored_api.py covers all major endpoints. Admin credentials: admin@zubite.bg/password. Clinic passwords are regenerated via admin panel. Cookie consent overlay may block UI interactions - use force=True for clicks.
mocked_api_note: No mocked APIs. All endpoints are fully functional. Email sending via Resend may not deliver in preview environment (unverified domain) but API calls work correctly.
